device.description: 12-bit 200-500 kSPS 8-channel SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: adc128s052.pdf (SNAS333E) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.8 timing specifications and Figure 1, p.16 transfer function (straight binary), p.17 serial interface, p.18 register maps (Tables 1-3)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the control register loaded from DIN on the first 8 rising SCLK edges of each 16-clock conversion (DONTC DONTC ADD2 ADD1 ADD0 DONTC DONTC DONTC); no read-back; reset 0 = the default first input

commands.name: Control Register
commands.note: each 16-SCLK conversion clocks the control byte in on DIN (bits 5-3 = ADD2-ADD0 select the input of the next conversion), the other 8 DIN bits are ignored; DOUT gives 4 leading zeros then DB11-DB0

pages: p.3 (pins), p.5 (ROC: VA 2.7-5.25 V, VD 2.7 V-VA, digital inputs 0-VA), p.8 (tEN 30 ns, tDACC 27 ns, tDIS 20 ns max; Figure 1), p.16 (straight binary), p.17 (serial interface), p.18 (Tables 1-3: ADD2-ADD0 select IN0-IN7)
notModeled: analog inputs and multiplexer; the conversion is clocked by SCLK (13 SCLK cycles), not timed: the result is the 0 V code 0x000 at once
the channel written in a frame applies to the next conversion; with every result the 0 V code this has no visible effect (ADD is stored only)

continuous conversion frames (N x 16 SCLKs per CS low) are approximated by repeating the 16-bit output pattern and re-matching the control word every 16 bits; the frame length rule (an integer multiple of 16 SCLKs) is not checked
SPI mode 3 chosen (DOUT changes on SCLK falling edges, DIN and DOUT sampled on rising edges); the datasheet allows SCLK high or low at CS fall (a CS fall with SCLK low acts as the first falling edge)
power-down while CS is high and between conversions (no digital effect); tCSU/tCLH setup and SCLK frequency limits
VA is also the reference; digital input voltage is specified 0 V to VA (VD 2.7 V to VA)
variants: ADC128S052-Q1 (ADC128S052QCMT, same datasheet): automotive grade, -40 to 125 C, same pinout and protocol. ADC128S022 / ADC128S052 / ADC128S102 are pin-compatible 8-channel parts for 50-200 / 200-500 / 500-1000 kSPS
